title: Keryx agent definition
description: Canonical, harness-neutral agent-persona definition. The frontmatter of a .metaproject/agents/<name>.md file. Compiled into keryx-shell spawn_subagent dispatch inputs or into a host-native subagent file; never executed directly.
$comment: The self-delegation invariant (delegation.allowed_entities must not contain this same object's name) is semantic-only because standard JSON Schema cannot compare sibling data values. Keryx enforces it in src/agents/schema.ts.

schema_version.description: Definition shape version. V1 remains readable as a leaf worker; V2 declares execution, tool-scope, and delegation constraints.

name.description: Unique agent id. Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens; must start with a letter. Doubles as the file stem (<name>.md) and the export target's own name field where the host format needs one.

description.description: Third-person statement of what this agent does and when to dispatch it. Injected verbatim into routing/selection surfaces; no first/second-person phrasing.

role.description: One-paragraph persona summary. Compiled into the prompt header immediately after the shared prompt-defense baseline and before the body.

tools.description: Allowlist of tool names this agent may use. An empty array means no tools beyond the target harness's own read-only baseline. Every entry must resolve to a tool that exists on the target (keryx agents verify checks this).

model_tier.description: Tier from .metaproject/rules/core/model-selection.mdc, resolved at dispatch time against the session's own provider by src/gdskills/model-tier.ts. Never a literal model name.

policy_profile.description: Named policy profile the compiler resolves per export target (e.g. a keryx-shell child policy profile or a host permission-mode name). Never grants beyond what the target's own policy engine independently allows.

skills.description: Skill/module ids this agent should have preloaded or may route to. Every entry must exist in the skill catalogue (keryx agents verify checks this).

stacks.description: stack_requires-style tags gating when this agent is dispatched (mirrors src/review/stack.ts's extractStackRequiresField vocabulary). Empty or absent means stack-agnostic.

output_contract.description: Canonical result contract this agent's reply must satisfy. subagent-result is the STATUS-first prose contract defined in src/harness/child/contract.ts; the only value this workstream ships against.

isolation.description: Whether the compiled dispatch requests worktree isolation on targets that support it (keryx-shell: src/harness/child/isolation.ts).

execution_kind.description: V2 execution role. Workers are leaves; orchestrators may delegate within the declared ceiling. V1 defaults to worker.

tool_scope.description: V2 tool source. Parent scope requests the parent's effective tool surface and is valid only for orchestrators; host authority may always narrow it.

allowed_entities.description: Agent entity names this definition may dispatch. Runtime admission also checks each resolved target and the review-run allowlist.

max_depth.description: Additional entity levels this instance may create. Review V3 supports general-to-leaf delegation only.

max_children.description: Lifetime child launches this instance may request, including retries; the review-run ceiling may be lower.

origin.description: Provenance for this definition. Absent only for a hand-authored definition predating this field.

kind.description: `authored` = written by a Keryx maintainer; `generated` = produced by the W2 per-stack agent compiler from a W1 stack pack; `imported` = brought in via `keryx bundle import` (W4); `learned` = graduated from the W3 self-learning loop after human accept. Mirrors `provenance.origin` in schemas/install-manifest.schema.json.

sourceRef.description: Id of the source this definition was produced from: a W1 stack pack id for `generated`, an import bundle id for `imported`, or a learned-pattern id for `learned`. Required in practice for every non-`authored` kind.
